title: Quantum Neural Networks
mission: Train a quantum classifier that separates the two concentric circles: the sign of ⟨Z⟩ on qubit 0 is the predicted class. It must get at least 92% right on a test set that you do not see.

prediction.question: With the data loaded only once into the circuit (LAYERS = 1), can the classifier separate the circles?
options: It does not exceed 50%, pure chance
prediction.explanation: With a single data upload, the output is a simple trigonometric function of the coordinates and cannot draw one circle inside another well: the result stays near 70%. Re-uploading the data in several layers (data re-uploading) makes the function richer, and with 3 layers the accuracy exceeds 95%.

hints: The starting circuit loads the data only once. Increase LAYERS to 3: each layer applies trainable rotations and then loads x again.
Train with optimizer = qml.AdamOptimizer(0.1) and weights = optimizer.step(loss, weights) in a loop of about 40 epochs.
Store float(loss(weights)) in history at every epoch. If the training accuracy is high and the test accuracy low, the model memorized the points: train less or use fewer layers.

messages.ok: Accuracy of {test}% on the test set (threshold {threshold}%), and {train}% on the training set.
messages.no_circuit: Define the QNode circuit(weights, x), which returns qml.expval(qml.PauliZ(0)).
messages.no_weights: Store the trained weights in the variable weights.
messages.overfit: Accuracy of {train}% on the training set, but only {test}% on the test set: the model memorized the training points instead of learning the shape. Use fewer layers or fewer epochs.
messages.no_reupload: Accuracy of {test}% on the test set (threshold {threshold}%). The circuit loads the data only {uploads} times: re-upload x in several layers (data re-uploading).
messages.low_accuracy: Accuracy of {test}% on the test set (threshold {threshold}%). Train for more epochs or adjust the learning rate.
